bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.brackhide: It got to the mushrooms first and it is not sorry.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.carrier: It is not chasing you. It is going the same way you are.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.chromefin: A whole shoal turns at once, as if the water told them.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.cragmole: You hear the digging stop. It has heard you too.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.cragwing: It has been following you for a mile, for no reason it will share.

bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.dunecharger: Nothing else out there is that colour on purpose.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.fenstag: It watches you the whole way across the clearing and does not run.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.ferrox: It will move when it has finished, and not before.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.glassfin: You see the shadow before you see the thing.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.mirewing: Loud, and entirely unbothered about being loud.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.nullprime: It waited. Whatever it was waiting for, it was not you.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.pileframe: It goes through the wall rather than round it, every time.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.prowlframe: You will hear it stop following you. That is the bad part.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.quillmite: Picking one up is a decision you make exactly once.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.shaleshell: It has found somewhere to be and it is not moving.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.shearjaw: Fast, and it has worked out that you are slower going uphill.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.sidetone: The noise arrives first and the cold arrives with it.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.siegehulk: Three metres of it. Bring the door down and leave.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.spallet: It comes apart when you hit it and the pieces keep coming.
